name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: One-time real-LCD calendar rendering benchmark. On the first 5wCal entry after app launch, time the same 35 cells in three modes: B=background+border only, F=current built-in 6x8 drawString digits, I=10 reusable monochrome 1-bit digit images transferred with drawImage. P separately measures date/holiday preparation. The final calendar screen shows B/F, I/P, and raw digit-bitmap bytes M. Benchmark runs only once per app session.
